listing_card.name: Samaritan Help Mission
listing_card.description: SHM aims to educate poor and underprivileged children in English, provide support to disadvantaged students, develop resilience in the community, uplift people socio-economically, and empower vulnerable sections to reduce inequality.

profile.description: SHM aims to educate poor and underprivileged children in English, provide support to disadvantaged students, develop resilience in the community, uplift people socio-economically, and empower vulnerable sections to reduce inequality.
profile.mission: To prevent exploitation and empower the underprivileged and disadvantaged children, youth and women through quality education, vocational training and generating employment opportunities to eliminate poverty.
profile.vision: Education, health and overall development of young destitute children, especially girls, and also to provide trade-based vocational training to the local community, primarily girls and women, irrespective of caste, religion or sects.

rawData.vision_mission_raw: SHM's vision is to provide access to quality education, life-skill training and multi-specialty healthcare facilities to empower and support the underprivileged population of the Tikiapara and Bankra slums. Their mission is to provide developmental opportunities to poor and needy slum children, with emphasis on young girls, by providing quality education and life skill training.

Vision and Mission SHM's vision is to provide access to quality education, life-skill training and multi-specialty healthcare facilities to empower and support the underprivileged population of the Tikiapara and Bankra slums.
